title: Summarizing attribution magnitudes
description: You can follow per-row explanations into a feature ordering.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: batch_shapley_summary allocates one attribution row per input row. You call the existing permutation helper for each input and store ph in Phi.
You sample test indices without replacement. The batch call uses the supplied background and permutation sample count per explanation.

steps.question: Can positive and negative attributions cancel in this importance calculation?
steps.answer: No. abs converts contributions to magnitudes before the mean across rows.

steps.description: You sort importance in descending order and draw matching feature labels. The recording supplies no chart or numeric ranking to inspect.
